transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what brings you here today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’ve been having a harder time keeping my head clear, especially at work. It’s not like I can’t do anything, but I’ll lose track of what a client is saying, or I’ll reread the same chart note a bunch of times and it just doesn’t sink in.

And then sometimes I kind of freeze on simple decisions that I used to handle pretty easily. I don’t know if that makes sense, but it’s been happening enough that I thought I should come in.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say I’m totally hopeless or anything, but I guess I have been less… interested in stuff.

Like, my guitar’s just been sitting in the corner, and I keep telling people I’ll make it to soccer or the shelter and then I bail. Even things I usually like, like cooking or going hiking, I’ll try to do them and it just feels kind of like I’m going through the motions. Like there’s not much point to it, if that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these feelings been pretty constant over time, or did they start after a specific event or stressor?

Um… I think it’s been about a month, maybe a little more. It didn’t come out of nowhere exactly.

The clinic lost some staff, and my schedule got moved into more late-evening coverage, plus there’s been a lot more crisis paperwork. I don’t want to make it sound like I can’t handle work or anything… it’s just, since that shift happened, this feeling has been pretty steady. Not every single minute, but most days.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I mean, I know everyone misses things sometimes, so I’m trying not to be dramatic about it.

But if I miss one detail in a note or I don’t return a call right away, I’ll just keep turning it over in my head like, “What is wrong with me?” And then it turns into this… like, I’m useless, or I’m letting the clients down, and everyone at the clinic too.

I know that probably sounds kind of harsh. I don’t usually say it out loud. But yeah, more than usual, I think.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?

Um… no, I don’t think so. Not in the way you mean.

I mean, I’ve had times where I’m busy or I push through on less sleep because of work or school stuff, but I wouldn’t say I felt unusually energized or like I didn’t need sleep. And I don’t think I’ve been more impulsive than usual.

If that’s the kind of thing you’re asking about, then… no, I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where your mood was low and you lost interest in things for more than just a few days?

I… don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had bad weeks before, like anyone, especially when things were stressful, but nothing that really stuck around or felt like this for more than a few days.

At least, not that I can clearly point to. Does that make sense?
Looking back, have you ever had any other times in your life, even before this recent period, where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?

I don’t think so… not really. I’m trying to think back, but I can’t remember anything that lasted that long.

I’ve had times where I was sad or stressed, sure, but more like a few days or maybe a rough patch, not two weeks where I was really down or not interested in things. At least not that I’d want to call that. Does that answer it okay?
Have you ever had any episodes in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things, even if they didn’t last as long as this current period?

Yeah… I guess, maybe not really before this, but lately there’s been that kind of thing.

Like, my guitar’s just been sitting in the corner, and I keep telling people I’m busy so I don’t go to soccer or the shelter. And even when I try to do stuff I normally like, like cooking or going hiking, it just feels kind of… pointless, like I’m only going through the motions.

I don’t know if that’s what you mean, but that’s been happening.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when your mood was so low or you lost interest in things for at least two weeks that it really affected your daily life, even if it didn’t last very long?

No, I don’t think so. Before this, I can’t really remember a time where it was that low for two weeks and actually messed with my day-to-day life.

I mean, I’ve had normal stress or bad moods, but not something like that. I hope that’s clear.
Can you recall if you’ve ever had episodes like this before—where you felt down or lost interest in things—before this current period, even if they didn’t last as long or weren’t quite as intense?

I’m not really sure there’s anything like that before this. I mean, I’ve had normal ups and downs, like anyone, but I can’t think of a specific episode where I was really down or not interested in things in the same way.

Maybe I’m missing something, but nothing stands out to me from before. Is that okay?

Have you ever had times in the past, even before this current period, where you felt down or lost interest in things for a few days or more, even if it didn’t last as long or wasn’t as intense as what you’re experiencing now?

I really don’t think so… not in a way that I’d call an episode, I guess.

I’ve had a few bad days here and there, like normal stuff, but I can’t remember a stretch before this where I was down or stopped caring about things for several days. At least nothing that stands out to me. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if it wasn’t quite as bad as what you’re experiencing now?

I don’t think so, no. I know I keep saying that, but before this current stretch, I really can’t recall anything that lasted two weeks like that.

There were probably normal rough patches, but not something where I was down or uninterested for that long. At least, nothing I can remember. Is that okay?

Can you think back and recall if there were any times before this current episode—maybe even shorter or less intense periods—where you experienced a low mood or loss of interest that lasted at least several days and affected your usual activities?

I’ve been trying to think of something like that, but honestly, I can’t really come up with a time before this where it lasted several days and actually got in the way of my usual stuff.

I mean, I’ve definitely had bad moods or stressful days, but I usually still did what I needed to do. Nothing really stands out as a period like what you’re describing. Does that make sense?
